title: Synchronous
body:
Timed by a shared clock. In [[Sequential Logic]], every [[Flip-Flop]] updates on the same
clock edge, so the whole circuit moves in lockstep. In [[Serial I-O]], synchronous means
the line is *always* sending, sender and receiver locked to a common clock, so there is no
per-byte framing overhead.

Opposite of [[Asynchronous]].
